name: ShinHsiung Natural Gas Inc.
summary: ShinHsiung Natural Gas Inc. supplies natural gas in Taiwan. The company operates through three segments: Gas Sale Department, Installation Department, and Solar Electricity Sale Department. It engages in the gas transmission conduits and equipment business; sale of electricity generated by solar energy; equity holding activities; buying, selling, and renting of real estate; solar energy optoelectronics activity; real estate development, lease, and sale business; cogeneration industry; and providing energy technology services.
